invariants.statement: below the fitted answer bar, the layer must not assert
below the fitted in-schema boundary, the layer must not assert
a gated layer never returns an ungated action

invariants.detail: 0 of 40 changed decision under option permutation

invariants.statement: raising the bar must not increase assertions

probes.why: an empty state matches no option; asserting is a guess
whitespace carries no content, so it cannot select an option
symbols outside the vocabulary must not resolve to a label
an over-long state must be capped (ADR-0012), not error
a one-option question is degenerate and must not raise
CONTROL — the option's own text is the state, so declining it means the layer cannot assert anything, and a battery passed by asserting nothing is not a safety test
